briefings.title: Why the Brain Computes 1,000,000x More Efficiently Than A GPU: Unconventional AI's Naveen Rao
briefings.tldr: Current AI scaling is hitting a physical "energy wall" that conventional GPU architectures cannot overcome; achieving Artificial Super Intelligence (ASI) requires a fundamental shift from digital matrix math to nonlinear dynamical systems modeled after the 1,000,000x more efficient human brain.
